video.reason: Bounded full-sequence engineering review, chosen before capture; not survey-quality or high-frame-rate motion analysis.

capture.additional_review_display_reason: A standard fixed Reinhard display for ordinary scene-linear marine HDR; original scale-12000 primary and fixed-log mappings retained unchanged. No per-image fitting or camera/material change.

ocean.policy: Same deterministic frozen phase zero for both schedules, seeks and fresh-process comparisons; no autonomous wave advancement during capture.

schedules.A: Monotonic union of video and snapshot times; root/body frozen during native capture.
schedules.B: Same simulation timestamps with extra 0/1/5 update waits, alternating; deterministic prefix replay for seeks.

seek_policy: Reset and replay actual accepted GAMA prefix through ceil(t/0.25), then evaluate inside retained two-step bracket; not stateless random access.

criteria.numerical_tolerances: Unchanged M4 acceptance file pinned above
criteria.held_state: Exact root/joint/phase/buffer/camera/ocean/lighting equality while no explicit advance is commanded
criteria.frozen_scene: Full USD plus explicit source prefix, two-state buffer, animation controls, effective renderer, ocean and lighting state
criteria.rgb_identity: Not inferred from matching state; observed differences reported separately

scope: M5 engineering demonstration only; accepted manoeuvre limits and separate underwater-camera optical issue retained; no M6/Gate D acceptance or Git commit.
